caption: The drawing depicts two identical human figures standing on a green, textured base with an inscription that reads "Eagle Bank." Both figures are dressed in blue jackets, red pants, black shoes, and gray caps, and they have light skin with dark, short hair. Each figure is holding a long brown rifle at shoulder height, pointed forward. One figure is shown facing forward with both hands on the gun, and the other is shown from behind with their left hand on the gun. Between the two figures, there is a large brown tree stump with visible grooved texture and an open top. The background is plain and uncolored, and the overall composition is simple with the objects arranged prominently in the center of the drawing. The artist's signature, W.O. Fletcher, appears at the bottom right corner.
title: Civil War Soldier & Tree Trunk Bank
